limitations: The source contains real changes for density fits, preparation error handling and SLR evaluation-product freezing; those are not covered by this pulse-only review.
review_basis: Pulse defaults remain twelve iterations and a 30 micrometre raw orbit convergence threshold.
The density controller is None and the density-only acceptance and g-update branches do not execute.
The primary native variational/MAP calls, final undamped covariance confirmation and raw state criteria are unchanged.
accepted_orbit equals the same native output filename previously copied directly; no additional native operation occurs for pulses.
Additional numerical-control validation and history fields do not change these fixed valid requests.
The SLR module, evaluate_native_slr and campaign-driver differences freeze evaluation-only correction products; none is called by this engineering fit_job replay, which performs no evaluation.
All shared XML-generation, data, preparation-reading, native-execution and covariance-reading functions are byte-identical.
scope: Scoped review of the primary pulse execution branch, not whole-project or density-branch equivalence
